response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrated C++ experience on Windows and has no visible exposure to capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domains — both mandatory requirements. His C++ exposure is limited to academic/bachelor’s thesis work and NI LabWindows, which is not equivalent to enterprise financial systems development. His professional work is overwhelmingly in JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and web stacks, with no SQL Server/Oracle or financial system context.
strengths: Strong full-stack and polyglot development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated contributions to open-source tools and CI/CD infrastructure
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops and public talks
concerns: No professional C++ experience on Windows in financial systems
Zero evidence of fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
SQL experience listed but not contextualized with SQL Server or Oracle in enterprise financial systems
